Volume pricing and custom terms

Each plan has session limits that reset every 5 hours and weekly limits that reset every 7 days.

Individual plans have usage limits based on the model and the number of input, cached input, and output tokens processed.

For teams, each member's usage draws from the usage included with their seat first. Once used, it draws from the shared extra usage balance at the model's token rate.

Pro and Max users can add extra usage balance.

You can turn off automatic usage billing. Team uses a separate account.
